stories.title: Risiko Cyberangriffe – Sicherheitsexperten: Blackout-Risiko wegen Solaranlagen

en.title: Cyberattack Risk – Security Experts: Blackout Risk Due to Solar Systems
en.summary: Security researchers warn that tens of thousands of solar installations in Switzerland are vulnerable to cyberattacks that could have serious consequences for the electrical grid.

stories.title: Emmanuel Faber: «Genève sera le siège de l’International Sustainability Standards Board»

en.title: Emmanuel Faber: "Geneva Will Be the Headquarters of the International Sustainability Standards Board"
en.summary: The International Sustainability Standards Board, which establishes corporate sustainability reporting standards, will relocate its headquarters to Geneva in mid-2027, making the city a global center for extra-financial accounting standards.

stories.title: Vers un double non net aux initiatives sur la neutralité et l'alimentation, selon le 2e sondage SSR

en.title: Toward a Double No to Initiatives on Neutrality and Food, According to 2nd SSR Poll
en.summary: A second survey shows the Swiss population is likely to reject both initiatives on neutrality and food policy in the September 27 vote, with over 60 percent opposing each measure.

stories.title: 2. SRG-Umfrage – Klarer Nein-Trend bei der Neutralitätsinitiative

en.title: 2nd SRG Poll – Clear No Trend in Neutrality Initiative
en.summary: According to GFS Bern polling data, support for the neutrality initiative is declining, with even backing among SVP supporters eroding.

stories.title: 2. SRG-Umfrage – Ernährungsinitiative verliert deutlich an Zustimmung

en.title: 2. SRG Survey – Nutrition Initiative Loses Significant Support
en.summary: A second SRG survey shows 64 percent of voters oppose a nutrition initiative proposal, while 33 percent support it.

stories.title: Flutwelle in Nepal – Kritik am Krisenmanagement der Regierung

en.title: Flood Wave in Nepal – Criticism of Government Crisis Management
en.summary: Nepal's government faces criticism for allegedly requesting international assistance too late following a recent flood disaster.

stories.title: Grippe-Impfung – Grippe-Impfstoff: Lieferengpässe trüben die Impfsaison

en.title: Flu Vaccination – Supply Shortages Cloud the Vaccination Season
en.summary: Swiss health authorities expect only 60 percent of flu vaccine to be delivered on time, creating supply chain disruptions for the vaccination campaign.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der deutsche Fussball ist ein Sanierungsfall

en.title: COMMENTARY - German Football Faces Structural Crisis
en.summary: German football has declined significantly over more than a decade, and newly appointed coach Jürgen Klopp alone cannot immediately reverse this deterioration.

stories.title: L'Arabie saoudite accuse les Houthis d'avoir visé La Mecque, les rebelles démentent

en.title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca, rebels deny
en.summary: A Saudi-led military coalition said it destroyed a drone launched by Yemen's pro-Iranian Houthi rebels toward the holy city of Mecca. The Islamic Cooperation Organization condemned what it described as hateful attacks.

stories.title: En direct, Moyen-Orient – La coalition menée par Ryad accuse les Houthis d’avoir lancé un drone sur La Mecque

en.title: Live, Middle East - Riyadh-led coalition accuses Houthis of launching drone at Mecca
en.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels denied accusations of attacking Islam's holiest city, calling them lies. The conflict has cost Washington 38 billion dollars.

stories.title: Contre toute attente, Alex Saab, un proche de Maduro, plaide coupable de blanchiment d'argent aux Etats-Unis

en.title: Against all expectations, Alex Saab, a close associate of Maduro, pleads guilty to money laundering in the United States
en.summary: Alex Saab, a former Venezuelan minister and key figure under Nicolas Maduro, pleaded guilty to money laundering in a U.S. federal court after agreeing to cooperate with investigators. His cooperation could potentially harm former president Maduro, despite Saab's previous not guilty plea.

stories.title: La guerre contre l'Iran a coûté 38 milliards de dollars aux Etats-Unis

en.title: War against Iran has cost the United States 38 billion dollars
en.summary: The U.S. war against Iran has cost 38 billion dollars since its beginning, according to the non-partisan Congressional Budget Office estimate through early August.

stories.title: Eine Zinserhöhung, und zwar sofort: Die Finanzmärkte drängen den Fed-Chef Kevin Warsh in die Ecke

en.title: An interest rate increase, and right now: Financial markets corner Fed Chief Kevin Warsh
en.summary: Financial markets are pressuring the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates immediately. Bond markets could shift into panic mode if the Fed delays further rate increases.

stories.title: Der Pharmakonzern MSD ist der grösste Schweizer Steuerzahler. Das Management versichert: «Wir sind hier, um zu bleiben»

en.title: Pharmaceutical company MSD is Switzerland's largest taxpayer. Management assures: "We are here to stay"
en.summary: American pharmaceutical manufacturer MSD paid over 2 billion dollars in Swiss taxes in 2025. The company's employees benefit from luxurious conditions.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der Vormarsch der Huthi offenbart die Schwächen der Golfstaaten

en.title: COMMENTARY - The Houthi advance reveals weaknesses of Gulf states
en.summary: Saudi Arabia lacks sufficient military and strategic resources to counter Iran and its allies in the region. Gulf states are fragmented and lack a unified approach to address Tehran's influence.

stories.title: Spiel mit dem Feuer: In China, Russland und Jemen kam KI beim Bau von Waffen zum Einsatz

en.title: Playing with fire: AI was used in weapon development in China, Russia and Yemen
en.summary: Experts have long warned about artificial intelligence misuse. Developer Anthropic recently identified multiple instances where AI was applied to weapons development across several countries.

stories.title: Eine künstliche Superintelligenz soll uns überlegen, aber doch unterworfen sein. Wie kann das funktionieren?

en.title: An artificial superintelligence should be superior to us, yet still controlled. How can that work?
en.summary: Researchers have grappled with ensuring superintelligent machines prioritize human welfare since the early days of AI research. The challenge of aligning advanced intelligence with human values remains unsolved.
